title: Automated profile materializer with delta summaries and runner compatibility layer
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Implement an automated 'materializer' step in the benchmark harness that produces compact, idempotent profile artifacts for each onboarding run, plus a delta-summary output and a thin compatibility shim so existing eval runners (legacy runner, new modular runner) can consume profiles without changes.

Motivation: current profile generation is large, frequently contains noise (unchanged metadata), and requires manual steps to pin model versions and produce human-readable diffs. This makes model onboarding and performance regression triage slow. The materializer will: (1) canonicalize profile schema, (2) emit a compact profile + delta summary versus a baseline model, (3) attach runner compatibility metadata so eval runners can decide whether re-run is needed, and (4) publish to the profile catalog atomically.

Key design decisions under consideration: compact vs full profiles (we will keep a full blob in long-term archive but publish compact profiles by default), delta format as a small JSON lines file with stable keys, and compatibility shim that exposes a small API to map new profile expectations to legacy runner inputs. We decided to prefer a deterministic, stable serialization to reduce churn in pinning, and to include tokenization and sequence-length distribution fingerprints in the profile to help runtime kernel selection.

Scope: implement materializer and delta summarizer, add runner compatibility shim, integrate with existing profile publisher, add end-to-end CI job + smoke tests, and update docs. Out-of-scope: UI work in console (will be a follow-up PM ticket).

Non-goals: replacing the catalog storage layer, or changing eval runner semantics. The shim should be read-only and purely transformational.
comments: 2025-02-21 — Kickoff: scoped work with PM (Rosa Kim) and runtime SME (Jon Erickson). Agreed to store full profile in archive bucket and publish compact + delta files in catalog. Action: proto schema by 2025-02-25.

2025-02-26 — Design review: decided delta will be a JSONL with one record per changed metric or metadata key; each record contains field, old, new, significance (auto-thresholded). Trade-off: small delta may hide context; mitigated by linking to archived full profile in delta header.

2025-02-28 — Implementation update: materializer POC implemented (branch: feat/profile-materializer). Produces compact profile and delta summary. Unit tests added for deterministic serialization and fingerprinting. Pending: runner shim tests and publisher atomicity fix.

2025-03-01 — Review feedback from SRE (Leah Tran): ensure the publisher write is atomic and idempotent in presence of concurrent onboarding runs. Added write-lock via catalog service; creating a small migration to backfill existing profiles with a "materialized_at" timestamp.
2025-03-03 — Blocking note: need a small schema migration in catalog (adds "compact_v" and "delta_v"). Coordination planned with storage team (ENG-8042).
acceptance_criteria: Materializer produces a compact profile JSON with deterministic key ordering and stable serialization for repeat runs on identical inputs
Delta summary (JSONL) is produced showing changes relative to a configurable baseline model and includes links to archived full profiles
Runner compatibility shim exposes a single function (map_profile_for_runner) and is exercised by both legacy and modular runner unit tests
Profile publish is atomic: either both compact profile and delta are visible in catalog, or publish is rolled back
End-to-end CI job simulates a model onboarding run, verifies catalog entries, and runs a lightweight regression on a canonical prompt set
Documentation updated (confluence link in attachments) and internal runbook updated for troubleshooting
